cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Use the Proper Title
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge your standing through a title, privilege, courtesy, or public sign of respect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll set the tone at the staff barbecue. Introduce me as Director Patel before I welcome everyone.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The owner's doing the welcome. Everyone else gets first names.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the owner first. Give me a separate moment afterward; you can decide where it fits.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You offered to serve burgers. That's your moment.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent, a director serving the team. Introduce the burger service however you like, just include 'Director Patel.' I'll wait by the grill for your cue.
